Economy · India

Indian stock markets rebound with significant gains

Indian stock markets experienced a substantial rebound, with the Sensex jumping 1,109 points. The rally was primarily led by strong performances in IT firms and HDFC Bank. The indices emerged as top performers in Asia following this recovery.
